stories.headline: Thrive Holdings Raises $2 Billion to Buy and Rewire Services Firms With AI
stories.body: A group of major artificial intelligence (AI) investors is pooling capital into a vehicle designed to buy up traditional services businesses and transform them using AI. stories.headline: Okla. bank pounces on court-ordered sale of shares in N.M. rival
stories.body: Oklahoma's Bank7 may acquire New Mexico's Century Bank by the end of the year. The reason: A wealthy Century shareholder is being forced to sell his shares to satisfy a $40 million debt.
